name: Reading corner: TARVA on the right wall, POÄNG and floor lamp by the window, dresser by the door, BESTÅ column by the closet
notes:
Alternative, re-checked 2026-10-23: a reading corner by the window in place of the bench, plus the BESTÅ column by the closet (F-63). The dresser moved 1.75" up, from 0.4" to 2.1" clear of the door's swing. 13 placed, 11 extras.
bed-1 TARVA queen (floor): as in a, x 94.75-177, y 34-97. F-34: 28" window side, 36" bathroom side, the edge of the bathroom door's 36" landing (F-31); F-33: bedding 28" from the heater face.
nightstand-1 IKEA PS 2026 pine (floor): window side of the head, x 165.25-177, y 22.25-34. F-33: 16.25" from the heater face. shelf-1 LACK wall shelf (top): the bathroom side's floating nightstand, as in a, so the bathroom door's 36" landing stays clear (F-31). lamp-1, lamp-2 STORSEGEL (top), art-1 PJÄTTERYD (top): as in a.
rug-1 TIOKRONA (rug): as in a, rot 0, x 40-158, y 18.5-112.5; the chair's front 1.25" rests on its edge.
chair-1 POÄNG birch/Knisa light beige (floor): window-side corner, rot 270, x 9-41.25, y 18-44.75, facing into the room with the window to its front left. F-33: upholstery 12" from the heater face (heater-depth-assumed); it ends 13.75" short of the window's eyeballed left edge, so not under it (assumed-position:window).
floor-lamp-1 TÅGARP (floor): behind the chair's left shoulder against the left wall, x 0-9, y 22-31; its reading arm reaches over the chair. F-33: 16" from the heater face.
dresser-1 STORKLINTA 6-drawer (floor): left wall below the chair, x 0-18.9, y 45.75-100.9, 1" below it. F-32: 75.9" open in front of its drawers to the bed's foot; F-31: 2.1" clear of the door's swing: it fits only if the door is where the sketch puts it (assumed-position:door; measure the door first); anchor-required (F-21). plant-1 FEJKA (top): on the dresser.
storage-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, white/Lappviken, 23 5/8x16 1/2x76" (floor, new for F-63): bottom wall at the closet end of the 70" clear run, rot 180, x 70-93.6, y 116.5-133: linens and towels beside the closet, 4' from the bathroom door. F-31: 3" to the side of the closet's 36" landing (x 25-67), assumed-position:closet; anchor-required (F-21: 76"; IKEA: must be securely anchored, never hung). It is the only floor piece that wall can take: the other 46" of the run is the 36" bathroom walkway beside the bed, where this 16.5" depth would leave 19.5" and even a 7 7/8"-deep BESTÅ frame 28.1" (walkway-narrow, F-30; F-34 tight). F-30: open floor in front of it, then 36" beside the bed to the bathroom.
mirror-1 NISSEDAL 25 5/8x59" (top, moved from the extras onto the plan): hung vertically on the walkway stretch of the 70" wall, rot 180, x 103.8-129.4, flat to the wall, so the 36" walkway stays clear: the full-length mirror between the closet and the bathroom.
Walkways (F-30): 36" beside the bed to the bathroom; 75.9" of open floor between the dresser and the bed's foot; the 36" landings in front of the closet and the bathroom door stay clear (F-31).
Window wall: nothing but the curtains and the reading corner, 12" off it. F-33 allows furniture 6" off the heater, but a cabinet there would box in the heater along the whole hatched wall (heater-depth-assumed), so no BESTÅ goes on it.
Extras: VALEVÅG mattress x1, DVALA queen sheet set x1, SMÅSPORRE Full/Queen insert x1, ÄNGSLILJA natural cover set x1, VILDKORN pillows x2, FJÄDRAR inner cushions x2 in VALLKRASSING gray-green covers x2, VALLKRASSING throw x1, BENGTA block-out panels x2 on the HUGAD rod x1 (about 107", centered on the window; cut the drop to end above the heater, F-33; assumed-position:window); PURRPINGLA laundry bag x1, kept just inside the walk-in closet: with the chair and the dresser on the left wall, no floor spot clears the door's swing, the closet's 36" landing and the route past the bed.
Not placed: the PERJOHAN bench ikea-60485339 (the chair takes its place), a second IKEA PS 2026 nightstand (any floor nightstand on the bathroom side stands in the bathroom door's 36" landing, F-31) and the BRIMNES wardrobe ikea-90574800. Same headboard reasoning as a.
Total $2,017.79: placed $1,328.90 + extras $688.89; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed, anchor-required (dresser-1, storage-1).
Design review 2026-10-23: the deeper nightstands covered the right 7 to 10.9" of the bathroom doorway with 14 to 15.4" in front, and the slim pine pair that replaced them still covered its last 3.75" at 23.25" out. With F-31's 36" landing in front of every door, the bathroom side takes the LACK floating shelf and the bed group moves up 1", so the bed's side is 36" from the bottom wall.
